'''Ralph''' (Japanese: '''サスケ''' ''Sasuke'') is a [[Character of the day|character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP176|Ariados, Amigos]]''. He is a student at the [[Pokémon Jujitsu Academy]].

Ralph took the Red classes of the Academy which studies battle techniques. He battled [[Mickey]] and won.
